id.description: A unique identifier for the room.

title.description: A user-friendly name for the room.

type.description:
The room type.
 * `direct` - 1:1 room.
 * `group` - Group room.

isLocked.description: Whether the room is moderated (locked) or not.

teamId.description: The ID for the team with which this room is associated.

lastActivity.description: The date and time of the room's last activity.

creatorId.description: The ID of the person who created this room.

created.description: The date and time the room was created.

ownerId.description: The ID of the organization which owns this room. See [Webex Data](/docs/api/guides/compliance#webex-teams-data) in the [Compliance Guide](/docs/api/guides/compliance) for more information.

classificationId.description: Space classification ID represents the space's current classification.  It can be attached during space creation time, and can be modified at the request of an authorized user.

isAnnouncementOnly.description: Indicates when a space is in Announcement Mode where only moderators can post messages

isReadOnly.description: A compliance officer can set a direct room as read-only, which will disallow any new information exchanges in this space, while maintaing historical data.

isPublic.description: The room is public and therefore discoverable within the org. Anyone can find and join that room.

madePublic.description: Date and time when the room was made public.
